role: 镜3 幸福｜FL2VA｜复用镜1同机位，男做鬼脸挠痒逗边说、女破功笑出声接话转身靠近、中间空距离消失
prompt:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, iPhone handheld footage with realistic skin texture, natural pores, and fine film grain, no plastic or waxy CG look. The same bright warm-white East Asian Chinese living room with the ceiling light on, airy and evenly lit, and the identical sofa framing as Picture 1: the woman at one end, the man at the far end with a gap between them. From the argument-start pose of Picture 1, the man leans in closer and keeps coaxing her, pulling a goofy playful face and lightly tickling toward her side; the mature East Asian Chinese man in his thirties, teasing and playful at a light, quick pace (S1), says in sync on camera: <d>[Chinese] 笑一个嘛，就一个——</d> The woman resists at first, then her mouth softens and she can no longer hold it, breaking into a bright out-loud laugh as she turns her body back toward the man so the gap between them closes; the mature East Asian Chinese woman in her thirties, laughing out loud as she gives in (S2), says in sync on camera: <d>[Chinese] 哈…你别闹了！</d> The camera holds a nearly static shot with slight handheld drift. The action settles into the exact posture, spacing, and composition of Picture 2 at the five-second mark, the two now leaning close together. Both faces stay matte under soft diffused light with no glare or reflection; East Asian Chinese features throughout, no brand or logo anywhere.

overall_soundscape: A warm living-room tone hums underneath with a faint appliance drone. Cushion fabric rustles as she turns her body back toward him and the sofa shifts under the movement.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
prompt_zh: 镜3幸福·FL2VA。复用镜1同机位。首帧起点，尾帧=两人靠拢。男凑近做鬼脸挠痒继续逗，画内同期口型说(S1)『笑一个嘛，就一个——』→女绷不住笑出声接话(S2)『哈…你别闹了！』转身靠近男、中间距离消失。语速正常偏快接话不留白。静止微手持，明亮暖白顶灯居家光，哑光真实iPhone感。声景仅居家底噪+转身布料声。

checks: state-change action with in-frame synced dialogue: man keeps coaxing while speaking (S1) -> woman laughs out loud and answers (S2) -> turns back and gap closes
